import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class C421 {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        InputReader in = new InputReader(System.in);
        OutputWriter out = new OutputWriter(System.out);
        int a = in.nextInt();
        int b = in.nextInt();
        int l = in.nextInt() - 1;
        int r = in.nextInt() - 1;       
        int ans;
        int len = a + b;
        int dif = r - l;
        if(dif >= 2 * len) {
            ans = std::max(a + 1, 2 * a - b);
        } else {
            //shift to the left
            r -= len * (l / len);
            l %= len;
            //std::cout << l << " " << r;
            ans = numOfDifLet(a, b, l, r);
        }

        std::cout << ans;
        
    }
    
    static int numOfDifLet(int a, int b, int l, int r) {
        int first = b < a ? b : a - 1;
        int last = a - 1;
        
        // abcd dd abef ff
        // abcd cc abef ff abcd dd abef ff
        
        std::string sb;
        char ch = 'a';
        for(int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
            sb += ch;
            ch++;
        }
        ch = l < a ? sb[last] : sb[first];
        for(int i = 0; i < b; ++i) {
            sb += ch;
        }
        bool used[30] = {false};
        for(int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
            used[sb[sb.length() - i - 1] - 'a'] = true;
        }
        int ptr = 0;
        for(int i = 0; i < a; ++i) {
            while(used[ptr]) ptr++;
            sb += ('a' + ptr);
            used[ptr] = true;
        }
        ch = sb[min(b, a - 1) + a + b];
        for(int i = 0; i < b; ++i) {
            sb += ch;
        }
        for(int i = 0; i < a + b; ++i) {
            sb += sb[i];
        }
        return numOfDifLet(sb, l, r);
    }
    
    static int numOfDifLet(std::string s, int l, int r) {
        bool used[30] = {false};
        for(int i = l; i <= r; ++i) {
            used[s[i] - 'a'] = true;
        }
        int ans = 0;
        for(int i = 0; i < 30; ++i) {
            if(used[i]) ans++;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static class OutputWriter {
        private std::ofstream writer;

        public OutputWriter(std::ostream& outputStream) {
            writer = new std::ofstream(outputStream);
        }

        public void print(const char* format, ...) {
            va_list args;
            va_start(args, format);
            writer << format << va_arg(args, const char*);
            va_end(args);
        }

        public void println(const char* format, ...) {
            va_list args;
            va_start(args, format);
            writer << format << va_arg(args, const char*);
            va_end(args);
            writer << '\n';
        }

        public void close() {
            writer.close();
        }

        public void flush() {
            writer.flush();
        }

    }
    
    static class InputReader {
        private std::istream& stream;
        private char buf[1024];
        private int curChar;
        private int numChars;

        public InputReader(std::istream& stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        public int read() {
            if (this.numChars == -1) {
                throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid input");
            } else {
                if (this.curChar >= this.numChars) {
                    this.curChar = 0;

                    try {
                        this.numChars = this.stream.read(buf, 1024);
                    } catch (std::exception& e) {
                        throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid input");
                    }

                    if (this.numChars <= 0) {
                        return -1;
                    }
                }

                return buf[this.curChar++];
            }
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            int c;
            for (c = this.read(); std::isspace(c); c = this.read()) {
                ;
            }

            int sgn = 1;
            if (c == 45) {
                sgn = -1;
                c = this.read();
            }

            int res = 0;

            while (c >= 48 && c <= 57) {
                res *= 10;
                res += c - 48;
                c = this.read();
                if (std::isspace(c)) {
                    return res * sgn;
                }
            }

            throw std::invalid_argument("Invalid input");
        }

        public static bool std::isspace(int c) {
            return c == 32 || c == 10 || c == 13 || c == 9 || c == -1;
        }

    }
}
